prerequisites: Must meet the requirements according to § 27 RPO.
All module examinations of the first four semesters must have been passed.
At least 170 ECTS credits must have been acquired.
All prerequisites for the awarding of ECTS credits for the corresponding modules according to the module handbook must be fulfilled.
Agreed topic from the student's field of study.

learning_outcomes.text: The candidate should demonstrate that they are capable of independently working on a practice-oriented task from their field of study, both in its technical details and in the interdisciplinary contexts, using scientific methods, within a given timeframe.

syllabus_topics: The Bachelor's thesis is typically an independent study with an engineering science or engineering technical task.
It should cover the topic in detailed descriptions and explanations and be prepared as a written elaboration.
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module examination. The importance of the grade for the final grade is determined according to the study and examination regulations (SPO).
